# Consulting Agreement

## 1. Engagement

Contoso engages the Consultant to provide the services described in
Schedule 1 []{.comment-start id="0" author="Ada Reviewer" date="2026-05-05T11:00:00Z"}for a term of [six]{.deletion author="Ada Reviewer" date="2026-05-05T11:02:00Z"}[nine]{.insertion author="Ada Reviewer" date="2026-05-05T11:02:00Z"} months[]{.comment-end id="0"}.

## 2. Fees and expenses

| Item | Rate |
|------|-----:|
| Daily rate | 1,200 |
| Travel | at cost |

Expenses are reimbursed [monthly]{.insertion author="Grace Author" date="2026-05-06T08:20:00Z"} against receipts.[]{.comment-start id="1" author="Grace Author" date="2026-05-06T08:21:00Z"} Receipts must be itemised.[]{.comment-end id="1"}

## 3. Confidentiality

- The Consultant keeps Contoso's information confidential.
- [The obligation survives termination for two years.]{.insertion author="Ada Reviewer" date="2026-05-07T15:10:00Z"}
- [The obligation ends on termination.]{.deletion author="Ada Reviewer" date="2026-05-07T15:10:00Z"}
